hints.title: Run Length Grouping
hints.text: Group identical consecutive characters into maximal contiguous runs.

hints.title: Boundary Uniqueness
hints.text: A special substring of length k requires that neither preceding nor succeeding characters match the substring character.

hints.title: Exact Length Equality
hints.text: Because boundary characters must differ, a valid special substring exists if and only if some contiguous run has length exactly k.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Counts run lengths of identical consecutive characters in a single linear pass.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining every substring of length k repeatedly does redundant character comparisons.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Operates directly on character indices using constant auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Simplifies boundary conditions by recognizing that runs must have length strictly equal to k.
